{{Quote|Trichloroheptane. Among other things, it's a virulent poison that forms an acidic mist when exposed to air. It would quickly contaminate the entire area.|Lya Charrel|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Spilling Chemicals|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>}}
'''3-5-7 trichloroheptane''' was a lethal chemical and a virulent poison that formed an acidic mist when exposed to air. Large amounts of it were stored on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Taris ChemWorks Factory|ChemWorks Factory]].
